description: Na₂PdP₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 57°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.62 Å. Pd is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.07 Å) Pd-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-62°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.62 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Pd, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Pd, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one P atom.
